name: drawer
title: Drawer
description: A panel that slides in from the side, or a bottom sheet on phones, for detail and edit views beside the page.

when: Viewing or editing a record while keeping the list in view.

keyboard.does: Closes, asking first when there are unsaved changes.

builtIn: Unsaved changes ask before closing in a real nested modal.
The bottom sheet has a grip to expand or close.

Drawer.name: isOpen
Drawer.description:
Open without a DialogTrigger (a URL, a row click). Inside a DialogTrigger, put `onOpenChange` on the
trigger instead: the trigger owns the state there.

Drawer.name: description
Drawer.description:
Under the title: "Jordan Lee · 14–18 Oct". When given, the drawer is described by it
(`aria-describedby`); without it (or with `""`, `false`, `null`) nothing is rendered.

Drawer.name: headerActions
Drawer.description: Beside the close button: a status Badge, a menu.

Drawer.name: footer
Drawer.description: Sticky at the bottom: the record's actions.

Drawer.name: position
Drawer.description:
The edge it slides in from, at every width (the app decides, e.g. `bottom` on phones): `end` (default) and
`start` are the inline sides and mirror in right-to-left; `bottom` is a sheet that snaps between half and full
height; `top` drops down from above.

Drawer.name: hasUnsavedChanges
Drawer.description: Closing (button, Esc, scrim, useDrawerClose) asks first: "Unsaved changes".

Drawer.name: motion
Drawer.description: `auto` (follow the device), `reduce` or `none`, for this component; the provider's setting otherwise.
